features.title: Temel Özellikler
features.f1_desc: PNG, JPG'den farklı olarak şeffaflığı destekler.
features.subtitle: Optimized for performance and quality.

how_to.title: How to Convert JPG to PNG
how_to.step1_desc: Drag and drop your JPG file into the designated area.
how_to.step2_desc: The tool immediately reads the file ready for conversion.
how_to.step3_desc: See exactly how your image looks before saving.
how_to.step4_desc: Click "Convert & Download" to save your new PNG instantly.
how_to.subtitle: Simple steps to high-efficiency images.

faq.title: Raster Format Insights
faq.a1: Converting to PNG stops future quality loss. It's best for images you plan to edit further or need to keep sharp.
faq.a2: Since we process files in your browser, the limit is determined by your device's memory, usually allowing files up to 50MB easily.
